pages.title: Digital Service Information Study
pages.body:
This fictional research fixture asks about a hypothetical municipal program. It takes approximately five minutes.

If you arrived through a respondent panel, your panel identifiers are validated before this page but are not displayed here.

pages.title: Participant information and consent
pages.body:
**Document ID:** `consent_main`
**Version:** `1.1.0`
**Effective date:** 2026-10-25

**Study purpose**

This fictional study examines how descriptions of a hypothetical municipal digital-assistance program affect opinions about the program.

**What you will do**

You will answer background questions, read one short program description selected at random, and answer questions about it. Participation should take about five minutes.

**Risks and benefits**

The study is designed to present no more than minimal risk. You may skip optional questions or stop at any time. There is no guaranteed direct benefit.

**Data and confidentiality**

The study records your panel participant identifier, responses, assigned condition, consent version, and operational timestamps. It does not collect your name, IP address, or browser fingerprint by default. The fictional research team controls the study database.

**Voluntary participation and withdrawal**

Participation is voluntary. Refusing or stopping does not create a penalty from the research team. Saving a withdrawal during the survey deletes this session's research answers and assignment from the active greedyQ database. Minimal panel identifiers and the withdrawal status remain for returning the submission and preventing duplicate participation. Previously downloaded files, provider backups and Prolific's own records are outside this automatic deletion.

**Contacts**

- Principal investigator: `researcher@example.edu`
- Data or withdrawal requests: `data@example.edu`
- Research-review office: `irb@example.edu`

These addresses and all institutional details are placeholders for fixture use only.

questions.label: Do you consent to participate in this study?
What is your age in years?

pages.title: Your current views
pages.body: The program described later in the study is fictional.

questions.label: Before seeing details, how much would you support a city program that helps residents use online public services?
Before today, how familiar were you with municipal digital-assistance programs?

pages.title: Municipal Digital Help Desk
pages.body: The city is considering a program with telephone and in-person help for residents using online public services. The proposal would operate at three libraries, five days per week, with an estimated annual budget of $600,000.

pages.title: Making Online Public Services Easier
pages.body: The city is considering a program with telephone and in-person help so residents can complete online public services more easily and avoid unnecessary trips. The proposal would operate at three libraries, five days per week, with an estimated annual budget of $600,000.

questions.label: At how many libraries would the proposed program operate?
How strongly did the description emphasize practical benefits to residents?
For data-quality purposes, please select ‘Somewhat agree.’
After reading the description, how much do you support the proposed program?
Please indicate your agreement with each statement.

rows.label: The program would be useful to residents.
The program would make online services easier to access.

questions.label: What is the main reason you do not support the proposed program?
Is there anything else you would like the research team to know?
What is the highest level of education you have completed?
questions.placeholder: Choose one or prefer not to answer

How would you like to describe your gender?
